units.source_text: 那天晚上，姑娘们多半是穿夏节便装，所以秀男在灯光下，误把苗子认作千重子。

en.t: That evening, most of the girls were wearing light summer festival clothes, so in the lamplight Hideo mistook Naeko for Chieko.

units.source_text: 然而，这不见得就是秀男眼花的缘故吧。

en.t: However, that was not necessarily simply because Hideo's eyes had deceived him.
